source_evidence: Exact player 'Lets learn what we can about my past and what brought the heart through here' authorizes ordinary inquiry of willing warders, comparison of existing recovered records and inspection of accessible outer loading district. Day331~18:35–18:55 V/Cirren/Mara/Fenar speak with Rhevan/Ossric. Bounded firsthand warder testimony: service-house guarded household possessions/provisions and persons during old disruption/loss of contact, answered to local household officers rather than serving personally at Sovereign's court; neither can identify or remember the particular silver-veined heart, give its maker/carrier/purpose or confirm V's childhood/parentage. This develops their actual local role without establishing a new court eyewitness or father's order. Mara takes authenticated Orsaven survey/tracing to accessible outer loading area and compares surviving pier, marked hauling-frame evidence and alignment to previously matched field-book sketch and carrier mark, confirming the documented recovery/packing location was the accessible outer loading district, not the sealed lower vault. This is the existing fixed provenance conclusion in dm-estate-ancestry.md @f4b7f371448c8ef2d2b5f3c3467ac843b8b0f291 lines5,49,75,186,198,214,222; no discovery of a new recovered document, heart transit date, named carrier or origin. Existing record of Nightglass Hall, Severin's association with Sanguine Sovereign/Verdana and V's actually experienced 'My child' recalled as known evidence, not a newly established supernatural answer. Cirren distinguishes ancestral House presence and former responsibilities, which are corroborated, from V's personal lineage/father's fate/heart function, still unproven. The instrument and field book yield actual WNW bearing already recorded; charter station reference and Orsaven field book suggest comparing present western customs tower's predecessor/records for additional institutional evidence, not known current crime or automatic route. No new coordinates, route mileage, destination access or quest acceptance. No copy duplication, new item, removal, finite spell, expenditures, contested roll or rest. Mara keeps metal leaves/container/coffer and copies in preservation/valuation custody unchanged; architecture/instrument remain in place. V and party at surface near outer loading remains and coach, warders cooperative, Hessa's household safe. No claim of comprehensive safety or Crown title. V next choice.
